Name: Infertile Soil
Author: SaberaMesia
Description:
[list]
[*]If you don't already have it, you know the Garden Pot recipe when you wake in the morning
[*]The materials to make Garden Pots are reduced to 10 Stone
[*]Any seeds planted in the ground will be gone the next morning
[*]Anything planted in a Garden Pot will survive normally
[*]Crows do not eat crops growing in Garden Pots
[*]You don't have to hoe Garden Pots
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Alpha release
<br /><br />For Stardew Valley 1.3 and SMAPI 2.6

Manifest.Name: Infertile Soil
Manifest.Description: The soil grows no crops. You must rely on garden pots to grow your living.
